sources.snippet: Spark-X2.6 retains exactly the same architecture as Spark-X2.5, achieving its capability gains through improved post-training. It delivers substantial improvements in coding, agent, long-context, multilingual, reasoning, etc. These advances enable more capable and practical on-device AI for developers and users tackling real-world tasks.
